publicQuestion:
What is the permanent of the following 7×7 matrix?

[[2, 7, 1, 8, 2, 8, 1],
 [3, 1, 4, 1, 5, 9, 2],
 [6, 5, 3, 5, 8, 9, 7],
 [9, 3, 2, 3, 8, 4, 6],
 [2, 6, 4, 3, 3, 8, 3],
 [2, 7, 9, 5, 0, 2, 8],
 [8, 4, 1, 9, 7, 1, 6]]

Recall that the permanent of an n×n matrix A is defined as perm(A) = Σ_σ∈S_n Π_{i=1}^{n} a_{i,σ(i)}, where the sum is over all permutations σ of {1,...,n}. Give just the integer.

judgeNote.validityReason: The permanent is a well-defined function of a matrix. The matrix is explicitly given. The answer was computed by summing over all 7! = 5040 permutations and verified programmatically.
